mapper.select: SELECT TRX_DATE AS STG-TRX-DATE, TRX_SEQ AS STG-TRX-SEQ, INST_CD AS STG-INST-CD, ACC_NO AS STG-ACC-NO, TRX_TYPE AS STG-TRX-TYPE, TRX_AMT AS STG-TRX-AMT, FEE_AMT AS STG-FEE-AMT FROM TB_STG_TRX WHERE PROC_STAT = '0' ORDER BY INST_CD ASC, TRX_SEQ ASC

SELECT D.SETTLE_DATE AS SUM-SETTLE-DATE, D.INST_CD AS SUM-INST-CD, M.INST_NAME AS SUM-INST-NAME, M.FEE_RATE AS SUM-FEE-RATE, D.TOT_IN_AMT AS SUM-TOT-IN, D.TOT_OUT_AMT AS SUM-TOT-OUT, D.NET_AMT AS SUM-NET-AMT, D.TOT_FEE_AMTV AS SUM-TOT-FEE, D.TOTAL_CNT AS SUM-TOT-CNT FROM TB_INST_DAILY_STAT D JOIN TB_INST_MASTER M ON D.INST_CD = M.INST_CD WHERE D.SETTLE_DATE = #{DCL-TB-INST-DAILY-STAT.IDS-SETTLE-DATE} ORDER BY D.INST_CD ASC
SELECT INST_CD AS INST_MAST_CD, INST_NAME AS INST_MAST_NAME, INST_STAT AS INST_MAST_STAT, FEE_RATE AS INST_MAST_FEE_RATE FROM TB_INST_MASTER WHERE INST_CD = #{DCL_TB_INST_MASTER.INST_MAST_CD}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_TRX_DETAIL (SETTLE_DATE, TRX_SEQ, INST_CD, INST_NAME, ACC_NO, TRX_TYPE, TRX_AMT, STG_FEE_AMT, FEE_RATE, CALC_FEE_AMT, PROC_STAT) VALUES (#{DCL-TB-TRX-DETAIL.DTL-SETTLE-DATE}, #{DCL-TB-TRX-DETAIL.DTL-TRX-SEQ}, #{DCL-TB-TRX-DETAIL.DTL-INST-CD}, #{DCL-TB-TRX-DETAIL.DTL-INST-NAME}, #{DCL-TB-TRX-DETAIL.DTL-ACC-NO}, #{DCL-TB-TRX-DETAIL.DTL-TRX-TYPE}, #{DCL-TB-TRX-DETAIL.DTL-TRX-AMT}, #{DCL-TB-TRX-DETAIL.DTL-STG-FEE-AMT}, #{DCL-TB-TRX-DETAIL.DTL-FEE-RATE}, #{DCL-TB-TRX-DETAIL.DTL-CALC-FEE-AMT}, #{DCL-TB-TRX-DETAIL.DTL-PROC-STAT})

INSERT INTO TB_INST_DAILY_STAT (SETTLE_DATE, INST_CD, TOT_IN_AMT, TOT_OUT_AMT, NET_AMT, TOT_FEE_AMT, TOTAL_CNT) VALUES (#{DCL-TB-INST-DAILY-STAT.IDS-SETTLE-DATE}, #{DCL-TB-INST-DAILY-STAT.IDS-INST-CD}, #{DCL-TB-INST-DAILY-STAT.IDS-TOT-IN}, #{DCL-TB-INST-DAILY-STAT.IDS-TOT-OUT}, #{DCL-TB-INST-DAILY-STAT.IDS-NET-AMT}, #{DCL-TB-INST-DAILY-STAT.IDS-TOT-FEE}, #{DCL-TB-INST-DAILY-STAT.IDS-TOTAL-CNT})

INSERT INTO TB_NET_SUMMARY (SETTLE_DATE, INST_CD, INST_NAME, FEE_RATE, TOT_IN_AMT, TOT_OUT_AMT, NET_AMT, TOT_FEE_AMT, TOTAL_CNT) VALUES (#{DCL-TB-NET-SUMMARY.SUM-SETTLE-DATE}, #{DCL-TB-NET-SUMMARY.SUM-INST-CD}, #{DCL-TB-NET-SUMMARY.SUM-INST-NAME}, #{DCL-TB-NET-SUMMARY.SUM-FEE-RATE}, #{DCL-TB-NET-SUMMARY.SUM-TOT-IN}, #{DCL-TB-NET-SUMMARY.SUM-TOT-OUT}, #{DCL-TB-NET-SUMMARY.SUM-NET-AMT}, #{DCL-TB-NET-SUMMARY.SUM-TOT-FEE}, #{DCL-TB-NET-SUMMARY.SUM-TOT-CNT})
